sources.claim: NVIDIA Innovation Lab is a 60-day program for selected Inception members; a separate application is required and approval is subject to availability and fit.
NVIDIA lists molecular dynamics, protein folding, and drug-discovery pipelines among Innovation Lab simulation use cases.
Innovation Lab access requires a separate application through the Inception benefits tile; selection and availability apply.
The $1,000 Lambda benefit requires a separate partner application; Lambda's offer page says a valid payment card is required and lists supported countries.
The 2026 PaG paper's in-house starting structure coordinates are not supplied in the publication materials reviewed.
The 2024 supplementary methods document the B29 alkyne, B1 O-glucoside, macrocycle roof propyl azide click reaction, and final NNC2215 formula.
RCSB PHX and LYX Chemical Component Dictionary entries are unrelated to the model-specific coordinate residue compositions and cannot define these residues.
AI Factory France free-compute eligibility requires France-based R&D and open research with a publication commitment; cross-border eligibility requires agreement between AI factories.
EuroHPC Development Access supports HPC application development/testing/optimization; the current call lists a 1 November 2026 cutoff and up to 2-3 weeks to resource access.
EuroHPC Fast Lane offers up to 50,000 GPU hours for SMEs/startups performing AI activities, for up to three months.
Google for Startups Cloud Program tiers and eligibility are decided by Google; application needs a Google Cloud billing account ID and separate partner application.
